nodes.name: AUDIT_REPORT.md
nodes.summary: Comprehensive code audit report for the DoomsGame tower defense project, covering 13 requirement categories (technology, cutscene, lanes, units, waves, damage, win/lose, HUD, menus) with a full checklist, build result, codebase map, and manual test scripts.

nodes.name: LINKEDIN_NOTES.md
nodes.summary: Preparatory notes for a LinkedIn post about DoomsGame, organizing the project elevator pitch, strongest technical decisions, key challenges solved, defensible metrics, tech stack hashtags, recommended screenshots, and hook ideas.

nodes.name: README.md
nodes.summary: Main project documentation for DoomsGame describing the Iron Man vs Doctor Doom tower defense game, covering features, C++17/OpenGL tech stack, architecture overview, build and run instructions, controls, screenshots, and known limitations.

nodes.name: Template.sln
nodes.summary: Visual Studio solution file that references Template.vcxproj and defines the Debug/Release x64 build configurations for the DoomsGame C++ project.

nodes.name: progress.md
nodes.summary: Developer progress-tracking notes listing rule violations to fix, missing features to implement, optional sound bonus tasks, verification steps, and submission checklist for the DoomsGame lab assignment.
